derivation: Derived GEOMETRICALLY from the real TY2025 Form 540 fillable PDF published by the Franchise Tax Board (https://www.ftb.ca.gov/forms/2025/2025-540.pdf, 6 pages, 169 fillable fields), the same method as the federal maps: for every entry, the widget /Rect of the field (read with pypdf) was matched against the printed line labels extracted with `pdftotext -bbox` on the blank form (a field is assigned to the line whose printed label row matches the widget's y-center within ~6pt), and then CROSS-CHECKED against the form's own field tooltips (/TU alternate names carried by every widget, which literally state e.g. 'Line 13. Enter federal adjusted gross income (A G I) from federal Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 11b.'); geometry and tooltips agreed on every entry below. FTB field naming is flat and sequential (no hierarchy): Side 1 = 540_form_1xxx, Side 2 = 2xxx, etc.; checkboxes carry the suffix ' CB', radio groups ' RB', and a qualified name equals the leaf name. Filing status is ONE radio field (540_form_1036 RB, 5 widgets) whose /AP /N on-states are the full printed labels WITH trailing periods and internal spacing exactly as stored on the widgets: '/1. Single.', '/2. Married/R D P filing jointly (even if only one spouse / R D P had income). See instructions.', '/3. Married or R D P filing separately.', '/4. Head of household (with qualifying person). See instructions.', '/5. Qualifying surviving spouse or R D P .' (the last is recorded for completeness; the engine has no QSS status). Plain FTB checkboxes (540_form_1040 CB line 6, 540_form_2026 CB / 2027 CB line-31 sources) have on-state /Yes (read from /AP /N). Header name/SSN repeat as SEPARATE fields on every side (2001/2002, 3001/3002, 4001/4002, 5001A/5001B; Side 6 has no name header) and all are filled. The dependents table (Side 2) is NOT transposed like the federal 1040: dependents run DOWN the columns by field number (Dependent One = 2003-2006, Two = 2007-2010, Three = 2011-2014; rows First name / Last name / SSN / relationship verified by Rect rows y 682-698 / 658-674 / 634-650 / 610-626 against the pdftotext -bbox label rows) and the form has exactly THREE dependent columns. Form 540 carries NO occupation field (unlike the federal 1040 signature block), so occupations are not filled. Fields deliberately NOT in this map: 540_form_1028 (county at time of filing — not stored), 1030-1034 (principal residence when different — not stored), 1039 (a second line-5 field per its tooltip; QSS is not an engine status), 2018 (line 12 state wages — informational, not an engine-stated line; left blank), 2028/2029 CB (line 31 FTB 3800/3803 sources — never a v1 method), 2033/2034 CB (line 34 Schedule G-1 / FTB 5870A — line 34 is a stated zero), the Side 3 use-tax/ISR fields (3019, 3020 RB, 3021 CB, 3022), lines 93-96 fields (3023-3026), Side 4 lines 98/99 (4003/4004) and all voluntary-contribution fields, Side 5 lines 111-115 and the direct-deposit fields (5008-5015 — bank routing/account are not stored), the voter/health-care/organ-donor elections (5016 CB, 5017 RB, 5018/5019 CB), and the whole Side 6 signature block (6001-6010 — the signer signs). Lines the CA engine does not state (40-47 credits, 61, 63, 72-74, 77, 91-96, 98, 99, 110-115) stay blank; the builder's manifest notes say so.
